properties.description: The class guard for defaulted edge properties. For every tool writers.json says draws an edge type (review_relations and the typed edge helpers) plus add_decision's related_to, and every edge type it draws, each property the schema declares WITH A DEFAULT must be a field the tool publishes that can carry every legal value, or be named in EXEMPT with a one-line reason; a new unlisted gap fails, and an exemption that is no longer a gap fails as stale. Seven exemptions: weight_basis on allocate, consumes, provides, part_of_flow and depends_on (no weight to state a basis for), depends_on's optional (open, same class), violates_rule's status (born proposed). Out of scope by design: create_edge/create_edges (free props map), draw_edges (runs the typed helpers), and operations that draw bookkeeping edges. A second test draws every defaulted review-relation property with a non-default value through review_relations and reads it back stored; a third requires every write tool named after an edge type to be in the map. On main c58305ba8 the guard failed with 12 gaps (review_relations and add_decision on CAUSES basis and validation_status, CONTRADICTS alignment, DEPENDS_ON optional and weight_basis, DUPLICATES basis).
properties.name: tests/every_defaulted_edge_property_is_exposed_or_exempt.rs
